proto-cog 1.0.0

- Initial release of the proto-cog skill.
- Instantly prototype interactive UI/UX wireframes, app mockups, and fully functional HTML experiences from a single prompt.
- Supports landing pages, mobile app flows, SaaS dashboards, design systems, and wireframes—fully clickable, not just images.
- Real output: live interactive HTML prototypes (default), with optional static images or PDFs.
- Requires integration with the CellCog skill for SDK setup and API access.
- Includes best practices, supported features, prompt examples, and recommended chat modes to streamline the prototyping workflow.
